Name: Flexible Cooking
Description:
Do you have 20 different types of tomatoes, and no way to cook with them? Well, I don't have 20 types of tomatoes... but I want to! This is a mod that lets you swap [b]any similar ingredient[/b] into [b]any vanilla cooking recipe[/b]. Do you have lots of extra crops mods? Use their varieties of fruits and vegetables to replace the vanilla Tomato, Apple, Melon, or anything else you can think of!

[b]Please note that this mod only affects vanilla recipes.[/b] Compatibility with modded ingredients is not guaranteed, but mod authors can scroll down for adding compatibility.

You don't need to have new crops mods to take advantage of this mod's features. Here are the benefits it offers for those with only vanilla items:
- More goats than cows? Use Goat Cheese in recipes instead of Cheese!
- Dress your salads or fry stuff in Truffle Oil for that fancy touch!
- Swap Sugar for Honey or Maple Syrup when baking!
- Similar types of fish can be used for the same thing, like making Crispy Bass with either Smallmouth or Largemouth Bass!

And even more stuff.

If you do have modded crops and forage, you'll benefit even more. Here are just a few examples.
- Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url]'s chili peppers to make Pepper Poppers
- Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url]'s Olive Oil to make Salad
- Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]WAG[/url]'s different flour types to make baked goods
- Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]'s Sweet Potato to make Glazed Yams

And even more! Feel free to experiment with items.

[b]This mod also "corrects" vanilla recipes, such as requiring Rice for Fiddlehead Risotto or Cheese for Eggplant Parmesan.[/b]

[b]Highly recommend using with Love of Cooking,[/b] so that you can pick and choose what ingredients to use with any recipe. You don't need LoC in order to use this mod, but you may be confused by other items being used in recipes unintentionally. [b]Love of Cooking recipes are automatically covered by this mod as well.[/b]

You need both the latest versions of Spacecore and Love of Cooking.
[b][u]
Configurability[/u][/b]
You can choose the way flexible ingredients appear in the cooking menu, such as Ingredient☆ or Ingredient (Any). View config using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] for options. By default, flexible ingredients will use a ☆ symbol. You can also remove the label to make the recipe look vanilla.

Some broader ingredient categories will always display as Ingredient (Any) to follow vanilla conventions. These are the following:
- Cheese
- Cooking Oil
- Flour
- Sugar
- Edible Mushroom
- Mayonnaise
- Chili

Theres another config option just for some additional personal tweaks to recipes. For example, editing Sashimi to require only real fish (fish that don't come from the crab pot) so it can't be easily farmed for cash. Or letting you make Stir Fry with any combination of one Root Vegetable, one Leafy Green, one Edible Mushroom, and a Cooking Oil.

[b][u]About Compatibility[/u][/b]
Compatibility with modded items is not guaranteed. In order for a modded item to be usable, the author needs to have chosen to use the game's "context tag" feature, which is an invisible item data tag. Not every item modder uses this system.

If you would like a modded item to be compatible with this mod, and currently it does not work ([i]please test first before asking[/i]), then you can (very politely) send this mod page to the mod author and ask them to context tag their items.

Json Asset mods, and mods not updated since before 1.6, are the least likely to be compatible.

Here are mods that are natively compatible. [b]If there are issues with items from these mods, you can report them to me[/b]:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia More Crops[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]More Flowers[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Artisan Machines[/url] (Cornucopia compatibility will be improved in future Cornucopia updates)
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour Atelier Goods[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22490]Bonster's Combined Crops and Recipes[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32385]Rose and the Alchemist[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3578]More New Fish[/url]

Here are other mods which I know have compatible items (feel free to let me know if yours does too!):
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35360]Botany of Teyvat[/url]

[b][u]For Mod Authors[/u][/b]
As a mod author, you can make any of your items compatible with this mod by adding context tags to your item data. [url=https://github.com/MizuJakkaru/Cornucopia/blob/main/%5BCP%5D%20Cornucopia%20More%20Crops/data/objects.json]Here's an example of how it looks in item data[/url].

If you are not the original mod author, but would like to tag someone else's items, this is possible as well. [url=https://github.com/6480k/6480-Stardew-Mods/tree/main/%5BCP%5D%20Add%20Context%20Tag%20Template]You can find a template mod here to download and copy[/url]. (Please be aware that this method is intended for items added through CP, not JA.)

This mod checks for a very simple and widely used <name>_item tag format. For example, an Heirloom Cherry Tomato should have the tag tomato_item. A Purple Carrot should have the tags carrot_item and root_vegetable_item. Pig Cheese should have the tag cheese_item. And so on. You can basically write anything that you think fits.

Here are the generic category tags that this mod checks for, aside from the item name tags:
cheese_item
mayo_item
chili_item
flour_item
wheat_flour_item
cooking_oil_item
edible_mushroom
root_vegetable_item
leafy_green_item
sugar_item

Please find a full list on the [url=https://stardewmodding.wiki.gg/wiki/Context_Tags]Context Tag Modding page on the modding wiki[/url].

For those interested in adding flexible cooking features to their own recipe mods, you will need to tag all the vanilla items. Please feel free to copy and paste the file data/contexttags.json into your mod. It doesn't break anything to add the same tag multiple times. You can of course also copy any recipe code from this mod.

Huge thank you to Elizabeth for being the original inspiration for this mod, and bblueberry for making the updates to LoC and Spacecore to accomodate a crazy mod like this.

[b]If you enjoy my mods, I would be honored if you would consider donating to my [url=https://ko-fi.com/6480k]Kofi[/url].[/b] [b]I use donations to buy groceries and food while working on mods. Thank you![/b]
